content_feed.telegram_post: 🤝 #ACQUISITION | Shadowfax Technologies Limited (NSE: SHADOWFAX) Shadowfax Technologies to Acquire WeFast for ₹23.3 Crore ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Acquisition Target: WeFast (Borzo India) - Consideration: ₹23.3 crore - Target Revenue: ~₹200 crore (adjusted revenue in CY2025) - Operational Footprint: 5+ cities with 32k+ delivery partners 📌 What happened: ↳ Shadowfax Technologies Limited announced the acquisition of WeFast to enter India's on-demand intra-city goods transportation market, extending services to small and medium businesses (SMEs) and C2C deliveries. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Netweb Technologies Launches Skylus Workspaces for AI Era
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Major new product platform launch for enterprise digital workspace and AI infrastructure.
content_feed.telegram_post: 🚀 #NEW_PRODUCT | Netweb Technologies India Limited (NSE: NETWEB) Netweb Technologies Launches Skylus Workspaces, a Next-Generation Enterprise Digital Workspace Platform ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Product Name: Skylus Workspaces - Target: Enterprise digital workspace and AI development environments - Platform Features: Unified enterprise workspaces, virtual desktops, containerised environments, and HPC access - Launch Date: November 27, 2026 📌 What happened: ↳ The company announced the launch of Skylus Workspaces to extend traditional virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) into a comprehensive digital workspace platform designed for AI-era computing requirements. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
